ExplanationParts.CorpusEarnedOpening: The saying under investigation is the exact saying a student has taken up and is instructed to keep raising, pressing, and returning to.
EvidenceBody: Zhongfeng Mingben tells students to establish their footing on the saying they investigate and elsewhere to raise it like one person facing ten thousand.

A ritual address instructs the practitioner to hold the investigated cue in the breast through walking and sitting; Tianzhen Dufeng Shan likewise directs the student to press against that cue rather than search in explanations.
The possessive wording identifies an assigned inquiry object, not any subject that happens to be discussed.

DraftEvidence.ZenBend: An uttered cue becomes a sustained object of discipline that is carried across postures and pressed without being replaced by explanatory thought.
DraftEvidence.CounterexampleOrLimit: The phrase does not name every discussion topic; the selected records require the particular saying being actively investigated.

DifferentThingTest.Reason: All targets denote the same particular saying held as the inquiry object.

DraftEvidence.AliasRationale: The alternates expose the possessive relation and ordinary “inquiry saying” wording.
